subject.title: Feature: support message read action for Telegram

question: Should Telegram `message read` expose only gateway-observed messages through a bounded plugin-owned store, and what default gate and retention policy should govern that data?
rationale: The missing code path is clear, but the permanent behavior decides how retained Telegram group content is authorized, stored, exposed to agents/operators, and documented.

options.title: Observed-only, default-off read
options.body: Add a bounded observed-message read path behind an explicit Telegram action/config gate and document that it cannot fetch arbitrary historical Telegram messages.

options.title: Observed-only, default-on for configured chats
options.body: Expose observed reads for configured Telegram accounts and chats by default, accepting a broader upgrade-time privacy change.

options.title: Defer behind passive hook design
options.body: Keep this issue open until the passive inbound observation/API privacy direction lands, then build `message read` on top of that contract.

recommendation.title: Observed-only, default-off read
recommendation.body: Add a bounded observed-message read path behind an explicit Telegram action/config gate and document that it cannot fetch arbitrary historical Telegram messages.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest combined signal from current blame on the central files and prior detailed review context on this exact issue.
